A2E benchmark results — April 2026

The A2E benchmark measures deploy-readiness of small LLMs on agentic tasks.
The April 2026 leaderboard shows Llama 3.2 1B scoring 86% when paired with
three guard rails. Previous iterations peaked at 72%.

Methodology: 420 tasks across nine domains. Each task requires the model to
call at least two tools and produce a structured output. Scored on first-pass
success.
